description: List mirrored executive orders (policy events) from the Federal Register feed. Filterable by signing-date range, affected sector, or free-text title query. Each event includes its Federal Register document number (externalId), title, signing date (eventDate), normalized affected sectors, full-text URL, and flaggedTradeCount: the number of official trades that occurred in an affected sector near the signing date. Matches are sector-level co-occurrence: the official traded a stock in a sector the executive order affects, within a window of its signing date. Sector matches are broad and many trades coincide with policy activity by chance; a match is a starting point for research, not evidence of foreknowledge. The matchBasis field describes match strength only ('sector' = broad sector match), not culpability, and matchCount is how many EOs matched in the window (a noise indicator).

sector.description: Filter by canonical affected sector (one of the 11 canonical sector strings, e.g. "Healthcare", "Financial Services", "Energy")
